messages:
Lina (UX): quick idea — instead of separate top-level Models and Datasets, propose grouping them under a new parent "Workloads" in the left rail. reduces top-level noise and matches how customers think about jobs + artifacts.
Mike R (Frontend): I like the grouping. main thing: we need a clear deep-link / URL contract so external links keep working. currently we have /console/models/:id and /console/datasets/:id.
Lina (UX): agreed. proposal: canonicalize to /console/workloads/:type/:slug where :type is models|datasets and :slug is the resource identifier. e.g. /console/workloads/models/llama-2. keeps intent readable.
Sam (Eng): implementation note — that will change path segments so we should add server-side redirects for old paths. also decide whether query params (tab, view) are part of canonical link or kept as ephemeral state.
Jasper (Platform): +1 on redirects. suggest 302s for 30d then 301s after migration window. also watch our CDN and internal proxies for path-based routing rules.
Ana (PM): timeline constraint: marketing wants permanent links in docs next week. can we promise stable redirect behavior?
Sam (Eng): yes — we can add a lightweight redirect middleware: map old -> new, preserve querystring. will need a small config file.
Mike R (Frontend): UX/route details: breadcrumbs should display: "Console > Workloads > Models > llama-2" even if the URL is /console/workloads/models/llama-2?view=metrics. breadcrumbs must reflect canonical grouping, not querystate.
Lina (UX): accessibility nits: when the left rail collapses, keyboard focus should remain predictable. ensure ARIA-current on the active nav item and a skip-to-main link so screenreader users aren't trapped. also visible focus ring when using keyboard to traverse.
Mike R (Frontend): routing options question: hash anchors vs full-path nested routes for in-page sections (metrics, logs, config). I prefer path queries like /.../llama-2/metrics because it yields unique history entries and is linkable without JS. hashes are simpler but less semantic.
Sam (Eng): agree — use nested path segments for major subviews. we can still support hash for intra-page anchors (e.g., #embedding-samples) but main subviews should be canonical paths.
Lina (UX): breadcrumbs and back-button behavior: if a user drills from Workloads -> Models -> llama-2 -> metrics, hitting back should go to llama-2 overview (not to Workloads). that means we should push a new history entry for metrics; using path segments handles that.
Jasper (Platform): telemetry: we should emit nav events like nav_click(section, subsection), deep_link_opened(source). this helps measure how many links are external vs internal. also flag redirects served so we can deprecate old URLs safely.
Sam (Eng): sample route map for frontend (draft):
```
/console/workloads/:type/:slug           -> detail overview
/console/workloads/:type/:slug/metrics  -> metrics subview
/console/workloads/:type/:slug/logs     -> logs subview
```
will wire react-router to render nested outlets.
Mike R (Frontend): small edgecase: browser autofill/bookmarking — we must keep slug stable. if slug can change (e.g., renaming resource), use opaque id in URL and show pretty name in breadcrumbs.
Lina (UX): good call. show pretty name in breadcrumb but keep permalink with id, e.g. /.../models/12345-llama-2 where 12345 is primary and the rest is cosmetic. on route load we ignore cosmetic slug changes but redirect to canonical if id missing.
Ana (PM): migration plan suggestion: announce deprecation for 2 weeks in-app, keep redirects for 90 days, block docs updates until we switch redirects to permanent. we'll need a short blurb for release notes.
Jasper (Platform): will add redirect config and a simple health-check to ensure no redirect loops. also ensure dedicated/private deployments can inject custom basePath if customers mounted console under a different prefix.
Lina (UX): accessibility follow-ups: keyboard shortcut to open navigation ("g n"), aria-labels on grouped nav items, ensure group headings are semantically <h2> within nav for screenreader sections.
Sam (Eng): I'll open the PR with route changes + redirect middleware. pinging @Mike R and @Lina for review.
Mike R (Frontend): sgtm — I'll add tests for history behavior and for breadcrumb generation.
nav-bot: deploy scheduled: staging deploy with new routes at 2024-12-12T02:00Z (dry run).
Lina (UX): great — can we get a quick usability run on staging tomorrow? 15 minutes with 3 people to verify back-button, focus, and breadcrumb correctness.
Ana (PM): I'll coordinate participants. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Mike R (Frontend): I'll update the styleguide and add a short paragraph about permalink semantics.
Sam (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/512 — includes redirect table + route changes.
Lina (UX): LGTM, leaving design comments on the PR for minor copy tweaks.
Mike R (Frontend): merging after tests pass. :rocket:
Ana (PM): done — closing this thread once merged.
